description: This file defines the CohortMembership class which models the membership of a patient within a cohort in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties for cohort, patient ID, start and end dates, and methods for checking activity status, comparison, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: CohortMembership
classes.description: Represents a patient's membership record within a cohort, including membership period and status.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the cohort membership is active on a given date.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the cohort membership is currently active (uses current date).

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the cohort membership.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the cohort membership.

methods.name: getCohortMemberId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ID of the cohort membership record.

methods.name: setCohortMemberId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID of the cohort membership record.

methods.name: setCohort
methods.description: Associates this membership with a Cohort.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the cohort membership.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the cohort membership.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the cohort membership.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the cohort membership.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Defines the comparison logic for sorting CohortMembership objects.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks logical equality between two CohortMembership objects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Creates a hash code based on patientId, endDate, and startDate.
